title: bench_core.stat_rows' p95 rounds half to even with round(), so p95_ms is one rank low for n=30 and n=574
goal: bench_core.stat_rows takes p95 at the nearest rank, math.ceil(0.95 * n), as bench_retrieval's freshness p95 does since BG-v5f5tn5y, so 30 samples of 1..30 ms give p95_ms 29.0, not 28.0 (recorded querylog-hooks rows n=30 and tool-speed warm pack rows n=574 used the low rank); the repro exits 0 once it prints 29.0 (SP-e4fm2ovk review, gap 3; the verdict p95 is BG-pjtajc2m)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_core as c;rows=[];B=type('B',(),{'row':lambda s,*a,**k: rows.append(a)});c.stat_rows(B(),'x','y','z',[i/1000 for i in range(1,31)]);p=[a[4] for a in rows if a[3]=='p95_ms'];print(p);sys.exit(0 if p==[29.0] else 1)
